subject: Draft MAP — SDK/Streaming Integration: owners, blockers, cutover target
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimblehealth.com>
Cc: Jenna Park <jenna.park@nimblehealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: Draft MAP — SDK/Streaming Integration: owners, blockers, cutover target

Alex — thanks for a productive discovery this morning. Per our call I drafted a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) slice focused on the integration build milestones you asked about (SDK integration, streaming, tool calling, structured outputs). Please review and flag any gaps. I attached a working matrix (sdk_integration_matrix.xlsx) and the MAP PDF.

Summary (proposed milestones, owners, targets):
1) Contract & SOW signed — Owner: Nimble Procurement / Redwood Sales (Marissa) — Target: 2026-09-21 — Dependency: countersigned SOW + pricing confirmation.
2) Network & credentials (VPC peering, firewall rules, API keys) — Owner: Nimble IT (Jenna) / Redwood Infra (Soojin) — Target: 2026-09-14 — Dependency: network team availability + IP allowlist.
3) SDK integration (JavaScript + Python) — Owner: Nimble Eng (Jenna) / Redwood SE (Dev Patel) — Target: 2026-09-24 — Deliverables: sample client, auth flow, streaming client example.
4) Tool calling & auth scopes (tool endpoints + OAuth scopes) — Owner: Nimble Eng / Redwood Eng — Target: 2026-09-24 — Dependency: API contract + test tool endpoints.
5) Structured outputs & schema validation (JSON schema + examples) — Owner: Nimble Product / Redwood Solutions — Target: 2026-09-28 — Deliverables: schema doc + test prompts.
6) Staging validation (end-to-end tests, perf smoke, token/cost estimate) — Owner: Redwood CS (Karthik) / Nimble QA — Target: 2026-09-30.
7) Cutover / enablement (rollout + enablement session for product teams) — Owner: Marissa / Nimble PM — Target: 2026-10-05.

Open blockers we discussed: SOC2 evidence for security team (you mentioned this — attach request), peering windows for your infra team, and SSO mapping for tool calls.

Asks for this thread: please reply with any ownership changes, feasibility of these dates, and who on your side will be primary for network and SDK work. If we align, I’ll update the MAP PDF and push a canary timeline into the shared Drive + HubSpot.

Attachments: nimble_map_draft_v1.pdf, sdk_integration_matrix.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimblehealth.com>

Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 18:40:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Draft MAP — SDK/Streaming Integration: owners, blockers, cutover target

Ben — thanks, this is great and captures the call well. A few quick notes from our side: we can take ownership of the VPC peering but our network lead (Jenna) is out next week (back 9/14). Can Soojin coordinate a peering dry-run the week of 9/20 so we can minimize blackouts?

Procurement: I added contracts@nimblehealth.com to loop them in on SOW timelines — we usually need 7–10 business days for legal review unless the SOW uses standard terms. Would you be able to move the SOW target forward to 9/18 so we can aim for sign by 9/28?

SOC2 evidence: our security team will request the SOC2 report and data handling summary. I’ll have Jenna share an initial list by 9/10.

Small ask: for SDK integration can you include a minimal streaming example and a sample tool-calling payload (one endpoint) in the matrix? That will help our eng team ramp quickly.

Quick notes from Sales Ops / Discounts perspective:
- We can offer a pilot credit of $15k for the initial staging validation window if Nimble commits to the 10/05 cutover target. If procurement needs more time, we should push cutover to 10/12 and re-evaluate credits then.
- I’ll own the commercial items (pricing sheet + SOW templates). Ben — I’ll need the final scope in the MAP by 9/13 to lock the discount.

Also recommend we schedule a 30-min exec alignment with your CTO if procurement pushes timelines — that usually clears cross-team blockers.

-Marissa

From: Dev Patel <dev@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 8 Sep 2026 16:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft MAP — SDK/Streaming Integration: owners, blockers, cutover target

Thanks — technical confirmation from the Redwood side. A few concrete items we should lock now: 
1) Streaming contract: clarify expected max concurrent streams and average tokens/sec per stream. We’ll configure batching and KV cache based on those numbers.
2) Model variant and output schema: we need at least 3 representative prompts and an expected JSON schema for structured outputs. If Nimble can provide examples, we’ll produce a schema draft by 9/17.
3) Tool calling auth: suggest OAuth2 with short-lived tokens for tool endpoints; we can provide a sample middleware in the SDK.
4) Network: Soojin can start the allowlist config; we need a list of source IP ranges from Nimble and any transit proxies.

Proposed sprint breakdown (two-week cadence):
- Sprint A (9/13–9/24): network dry-run, SDK basic auth + streaming sample, schema draft.
- Sprint B (9/27–10/08): tool-calling integration, end-to-end staging tests, perf tuning.

Attachments: network_peering_checklist.md (high-level steps for peering and firewall), I updated the sdk_integration_matrix with columns for sample payloads and test endpoints.

Regards,
Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
dev@redwood.com

Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 19:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Draft MAP — SDK/Streaming Integration: owners, blockers, cutover target (finalized targets)

Thanks everyone — consolidating agreed updates and next steps below. Please reply only if anything below is incorrect. If silent, I’ll assume agreement and update the MAP + HubSpot record by EOD tomorrow.

Agreed MAP (finalized targets):
- SOW delivery to Procurement: target 2026-09-18 — Owner: Ben / Marissa.
- Network & creds dry-run: target 2026-09-20 — Owner: Soojin / Jenna.
- SDK streaming + sample payloads: target 2026-09-24 — Owner: Dev / Jenna.
- Structured outputs schema draft: target 2026-09-17 (Dev to produce on examples) — Owner: Nimble PM + Dev.
- Staging validation: target 2026-09-30 — Owner: Karthik / Nimble QA.
- Cutover + enablement: target 2026-10-12 (per Marissa / procurement cadence) — Owner: Marissa / Nimble PM.

Action items (owners & immediate asks):
- Alex / Nimble: share SOC2 evidence and list of IP ranges by 2026-09-10 (assign to contracts@nimblehealth.com).
- Jenna: confirm network windows (Jenna -> Soojin sync) and provide test endpoint for tool calls by 2026-09-14.
- Dev: update sdk_integration_matrix with streaming sample and tool-calling middleware by 2026-09-13.
- Marissa: finalize credit decision contingent on signed MAP and SOW; will confirm by 2026-09-13.
- Ben: update MAP PDF and HubSpot, schedule MAP sync (30 min) for Tue 2026-09-14 16:00 EDT — calendar invite to follow.

Attachments pushed to Drive: nimble_map_draft_v1.pdf, sdk_integration_matrix.xlsx, network_peering_checklist.md

Thanks — looking forward to the next sync.

Ben Carter
